from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetrics(BaseModel):
    """Financial metrics for one company's quarterly report relevant to capital return and FCF."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Quarterly period in YYYY-MM format")
    net_cash_financing: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from financing activities (negative = outflow)")
    shares_outstanding_current: float | None = Field(description="Weighted-average basic shares outstanding in current period (in millions or actual count as reported)")
    shares_outstanding_previous: float | None = Field(description="Weighted-average basic shares outstanding in prior year period for comparison")
    net_cash_operating: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from operating activities (can be positive or negative)")
    net_cash_investing: float | None = Field(description="Net cash from investing activities (can be positive or negative)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_metrics: list[FinancialMetrics]
